title: thumbnail and preview support for .nc files in addition to .gcode files
author: jennib

status.label: Bounded File Explorer enhancement
status.detail: The requested extension maps directly to the existing G-code preview and thumbnail registration path.

next_action.label: Complete implementation design
next_action.reason: Confirm registration, parser compatibility, collision handling, and tests before exposing an approval action.

judgment.rationale: The request has a concrete acceptance test and current source exposes a narrow extension-registration point shared by the G-code preview and thumbnail handlers.
evidence: Renaming the reporter's .nc file to .gcode makes the existing preview work.
src/common/utils/modulesRegistry.h currently defines ExtGCode as only .gcode and passes it to both G-code handlers.
Existing G-code preview and thumbnail tests provide focused locations for .nc coverage.
judgment.recommended_action: Develop an implementation-grade design for registering .nc with the G-code handlers and validating representative CNC files.

issue_context.summary: CNC G-code commonly uses the .nc extension, but PowerToys only registers its G-code preview and thumbnail handlers for .gcode.
known_information: The same file previews successfully after its extension is changed from .nc to .gcode.
The current registry extension list contains .gcode but not .nc.
Both preview and thumbnail registration consume the shared ExtGCode list.
inferences: Adding .nc to the shared registration list may provide the requested behavior without changing parsing, subject to representative-file tests.
Some .nc files may contain controller-specific dialects or no embedded thumbnail, so graceful fallback still needs verification.
issue_context.analysis: The report demonstrates parser compatibility for at least one real file, and source inspection identifies a small, testable integration point. A detailed design should still cover shell registration ownership and non-thumbnail .nc content before approval.
initial_investigation: Located ExtGCode and both handler change sets in src/common/utils/modulesRegistry.h.
Located existing GcodePreviewHandler and GcodeThumbnailProvider unit-test projects.

information_gaps.information: Representative .nc samples with and without embedded preview images
information_gaps.why_needed: They determine whether extension registration alone is sufficient and prove graceful behavior across common CNC variants.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Use small non-sensitive CNC samples or generated fixtures in the implementation tests.
